name: pboc_get_inflation
description:
Chinese price indices, monthly, from FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, OECD series): cpi (all items), core_cpi (less food and energy) or ppi.
Returns: series_code (FRED id), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): measure (cpi, core_cpi, ppi; default cpi); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; the last N observations; with no dates it looks back N x 45 days); omit all three for the full history.
For growth, trade and other indicators use pboc_get_economic_indicator. Needs a FRED API key (FRED_API_KEY, config fred.api.key); without one the call fails with a message saying so.
Example: {"measure": "cpi", "recent_periods": 12}
